source.publication: 2025 PIT-RES Resident Individual Income Tax Return Instructions and Form PIT-RES 2025; tax rate schedule from 30 Del. C. §1102(a)(14)
source.section: Instructions PDF p.6 Line 6 Pension Exclusion (under-60 rules, 60-or-over worksheet lines 1-4, eligible retirement income, NOTE, example); Instructions PDF p.8 Line 21 Additional Standard Deduction items 1-5; Form PIT-RES Lines 1-12, 20a-24, 26-27b, 32-33; Instructions PDF p.5 Line 1; PDF p.8 Line 20a standard deduction table, Line 24, Line 27a; PDF p.9 Line 27b; tax rate schedule 30 Del. C. §1102(a)(14) (record brackets cite)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = ira distribution (you) 20,000.00 + public pension paid by DE (you) 30,000.00 + interest 2,050.00 = 52,050.00. Federal taxable income = 52,050.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 additional for age 65 or older = 34,300.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form PIT-RES (filing status 1 single, Column B): Line 1 federal AGI 52,050.00; Line 2 other states' obligations interest 0.00; Line 3 0.00; Line 4 total 52,050.00. Line 5 U.S. obligations interest 0.00. Line 6 pension exclusion, you (age 70): worksheet line 1 pension 30,000.00; line 2 eligible retirement income = IRA 20,000.00 + interest 2,050.00 = 22,050.00; line 3 = 52,050.00; line 4 lesser of 52,050.00 and 12,500.00 = 12,500.00. Line 7 0.00; Line 8a 0.00; Line 8b 0.00. Line 9 (Lines 5-8b) = 12,500.00. Line 10 = 52,050.00 - 12,500.00 = 39,550.00. Line 11 0.00 (Line 11 worksheet: Line 10 is over 10,000.00, so no). Line 12 Delaware AGI = 39,550.00. Line 20a standard deduction (filing status 1) 3,250.00; Line 21 additional standard deduction 1 box(es) for 65 or over x 2,500.00 = 2,500.00; Line 22 = 5,750.00. Line 23 taxable income = 39,550.00 - 5,750.00 = 33,800.00. Line 24 tax, §1102(a)(14) schedule as numbers: 2.2% x 3,000.00 = 66.00 + 3.9% x 5,000.00 = 195.00 + 4.8% x 10,000.00 = 480.00 + 5.2% x 5,000.00 = 260.00 + 5.55% x 8,800.00 = 488.40; total 1,489.40 (the Division's tax table, not in the sources, would give a row figure; expected keeps the formula). Line 25 0.00; Line 26 = 1,489.40. Line 27a personal credits 1 x 110.00 = 110.00; Line 27b additional credits 1 box(es) for 60 or over x 110.00 = 110.00; Line 32 total non-refundable credits 220.00. Line 33 balance = 1,489.40 - 220.00 = 1,269.40.
